result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: a loading spinner is stuck over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image in the 'Popular right now' section, suggesting an unfinished or failed image load. The rest of the layout appears intact.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner is displayed in the center of the Tokumaru Ramen Bar hero image, covering the food photo. It appears to be a stuck loading state, so the card looks unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Make sure the image finishes loading and the spinner is removed once content is ready. Add a timeout or error fallback so a placeholder or retry state appears instead of an indefinite spinner.
